title: Yoisaki Kanade — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks for listening to the demo, everyone. I'll make sure to keep your feedback in mind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'm looking forward to the finished song.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are we going back now?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What, already? But we've barely had a chance to talk to Miku and everyone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna chat some more first!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't mind, but what do you want to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: About... Lots of things! Right, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I didn't have anything specific in mind...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... I have something I want to ask you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ask me...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Your birthday is coming up.
I was wondering what you'll do to celebrate...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? My birthday...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't have any plans right now. It's a whole two weeks from now, after all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Mizuki, Mafuyu. Why don't we talk about that thing?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What thing?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, we were looking around for a place to hold your birthday party, and we found a cafe that looks great.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The cafe serves a special cake, and if you tell them it's for a birthday, they add on some extras.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They've even been featured on TV, and it's great how they make every single cake to order!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, let's have a party there! We should still be able to make a reservation, too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You three were doing all that for me? I didn't even realize.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That sounds great, then. Let's do it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
We're going to throw you a great party!
Look forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you both so much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And thank you too, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Now you have plans.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't expect anyone to already be planning things. It's two whole weeks away, after all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! How do you think we feel on the planning side? It's more like, “we only have two weeks left!”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, really...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Have you all been working on this for a while, then?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um... We started looking for a place once things calmed down after New Year's, so it's been...about a month?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's right. Though at that point it was just scrolling through restaurant review sites during downtime...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So it's been a while, but it wasn't all that much actual work.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe you thought that far in advance.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Of course we did. You're our friend, and this is your birthday we're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You only get one a year. We gotta make sure there's no regrets later♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade... Please come visit SEKAI on your birthday too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Because, um... We also want to celebrate with you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Got it. We'll all come by.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's still some time before it happens, but I hope you enjoy your party with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks.
The day of the party
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you all for coming. Especially since I know you're using your days off for this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, don't mention it♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It would've been nice to celebrate on your actual birthday, but we wouldn't have had time to hang out, with school and all!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: School, that thing you're always so concerned with?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! Don't mention that either♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, where's the cafe we're going to?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's closer to Miyamasuzaka, so over that wa—
Oh, there they are! Quick, hurry!
Hey, be more careful! What if she sees us?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Was that...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't get a good look, but I could have sworn I know them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh, really? I didn't notice anything at all!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. If it was someone you knew, Kanade, you'd have recognized them straight away...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, maybe... I guess I imagined it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, was that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
The light's turning green.
We don't have a lot of time before our reservation.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Let's go.
se_walk_women_001_4
That was close. I thought she wouldn't notice us with all the people around...
It's okay, I don't think she realized. Come on, let's hurry after them.
A Certain Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So this is the cafe you found?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. It's a bit sunny, but the vibe is super relaxed. It's got a nice atmosphere to it, see?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the staff wear super cute uniforms♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll be shocked, Kanade, so you'd better get ready!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A-Are they really that cute?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hello there!
I have a table reserved under Akiyama♪
Right away!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, that voice...
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you for your reservation! Welcome to carino/carina!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Tenma...?
